references.text: Lachish is mentioned as one of the five Amorite kings' cities that allied against Gibeon
Joshua conquered Lachish and struck the city with the edge of the sword
Joshua conquered Eglon after leaving Lachish
The king of Eglon is mentioned among the defeated kings
The king of Lachish is mentioned among the defeated kings
Lachish is mentioned in connection with the murder of King Amaziah, who fled there
King Hezekiah sent a message to the Assyrian king at Lachish
The Assyrian king had left Lachish when Rabshakeh returned
Lachish and Eglon are mentioned as the last fortified cities in Judah during the Babylonian siege
